b1-adv-miteinander: The two brothers always speak with one another in a friendly way.
The family sits at the table and talks, each one with the others.
In a good team, people help one another. Which adverb means 'with each other'?
b1-v-betruegen: A shopkeeper gives you less change than he should, and he does it on purpose.
He tells his wife he works late but secretly meets another woman. He is not faithful to her.
A fake website takes people's money and never sends anything. Which verb means 'to cheat' or 'to defraud'?
b1-n-aufenthalt: During your three-week visit to Germany you live in Hamburg.
Your train has a 20-minute stop in the station before it goes on.
Your visa lets you remain in the country for 90 days. Which word means 'stay'?
b1-adj-einzig: There is just one seat left in the whole bus, and nobody else has one.
You are the one child at the party. There is not another.
Only one thing matters to you, nothing else. Which adjective means 'only' or 'sole'?
b1-n-schularbeit: Tomorrow your class writes a test on maths.
After school you sit at your desk and do the exercises the teacher gave you to finish at home.
Your mother asks: 'Have you done your tasks for school?' Which word means 'homework'?
b1-n-fussgaenger: A man walks on the pavement and waits for the green light to cross the street.
At the zebra crossing, a man on foot crosses and the cars have to stop.
A road sign shows a figure of a person walking. Which word means a male 'pedestrian'?
b1-v-erstellen: You open a program and make a list of all the guests for the party.
An engineer produces a plan for a new bridge.
The accountant prepares the annual report. Which verb means 'to draw up' or 'to create'?
b1-n-taeter: The police find fingerprints and want to know who did the robbery. They look for the man responsible.
The court finds the man who committed the crime.
The police arrest the man who carried out the theft. Which word means a male 'culprit'?
b1-n-wirklichkeit: You dreamed that you could fly, but when you wake up, you remember the real world.
In the film everything is perfect, but life as it truly is, is not.
A friend says your plan is nice in theory, but what happens in real life is different. Which word means 'reality'?
b1-adj-fliessend: After five years in Germany, you speak German without stopping to look for words.
In the kitchen, the tap gives hot and cold water that moves continuously.
A job ad asks for English that is smooth and without mistakes. Which adjective means 'fluent'?
b1-v-unterscheiden: Twin sisters look alike, but their mother can tell which is which.
A wine expert can tell different grapes by their flavour.
You learn to see the difference between two similar words. Which verb means 'to distinguish'?
b1-n-betreuung: While the parents work, a person looks after the children at the day-care centre.
A nurse takes care of an old woman at home.
A university offers a programme where someone guides you through your thesis. Which word means 'support' or 'care'?
b1-n-faktor: Price is one of several things that influence your decision to buy a car.
In maths, two numbers multiplied together give a result. Each of those numbers is one of these.
The weather was an important element in the result of the race. Which word means 'factor'?
b1-n-fahrbahn: Cars drive on the part of the street between the pavements.
A sign says that cyclists should use the part of the street meant for vehicles.
Children should never play on the part of the road where cars go. Which word means 'roadway'?
b1-v-sich-vergnuegen: At the fair the kids go on rides and eat sweets and have a great time.
On Saturday night, the students go dancing and enjoy themselves.
Your friend says he wants to amuse himself at the party. Which verb means 'to enjoy oneself'?
b1-adj-ausschliesslich: This room is for staff only, no one else.
She eats only vegetables, nothing else.
The shop sells nothing but shoes. Which word means 'exclusively'?
b1-n-textaufbau: The teacher says an essay needs a beginning, a middle and an end. She talks about how the whole text is organised.
You draw boxes to plan which paragraph comes where in your report.
In the writing course you learn how paragraphs link into one piece. Which word means 'text structure'?
b1-adv-rueckwaerts: You are parking your car and need to move it back into the space, looking over your shoulder.
A child walks with his face forward but takes steps toward his back.
You say the alphabet starting with Z and ending with A. Which adverb means 'backwards'?
b1-n-karriere: She started as a trainee and in ten years became the director of the company. Her professional path went up quickly.
He puts work first because he wants to climb the ladder in his profession.
At school the counsellor asks what job path you want. Which word means 'career'?
b1-v-einfuegen: You copy a sentence from one document and put it into another.
You add a new word to the middle of a sentence you have written.
The last puzzle piece must be put into its place. Which verb means 'to insert'?
b1-n-bedeutung: You look up an unknown word in the dictionary to find out what it stands for.
The teacher says the discovery is very important for science.
A road sign shows a red circle. What does it express? Which word means 'meaning'?
b1-n-gesellschaft: A researcher studies how all the people living together in a country behave and are organised.
You sit alone at dinner and wish for somebody to be there with you.
The newspaper discusses problems of the whole community of people in a nation. Which word means 'society'?
b1-adj-schuld: The vase is broken, and your little brother says it was your fault.
Nobody wants to take the blame for the accident.
You forgot to lock the door, so it is your fault that the thief came in. Which word describes someone who is 'to blame'?
b1-v-enttaeuschen: You promised your child a trip to the zoo but cancel it, and he feels let down.
The film had a lot of hype but was boring. It did not meet your hopes.
The coach is upset because the players did not meet his hopes. Which verb means 'to disappoint'?
b1-n-pinguin: A black and white bird walks upright on the ice in Antarctica and cannot fly.
At the zoo, a bird that looks like it wears a tuxedo waddles and swims.
Which bird lives in the cold south, swims well, cannot fly and has a white belly? Which word means 'penguin'?
b1-n-wert: An antique expert says the vase is worth 5,000 euros.
The price tag says one number, but what the thing is really worth to you is more.
The test result shows a number for your blood sugar. Which word means 'value'?
b1-n-semmel: In the morning at the baker's, you buy a small round bread with a crispy crust to eat with butter and cheese.
For breakfast you cut open a small round bread and put ham in it.
In Bavaria you ask for a small round bread at the bakery. Which word means 'bread roll'?
b1-v-schauen: You turn your eyes toward the window to see the snow.
In the evening you sit on the sofa and view a film on TV.
Your mother calls you to come and see something. Which verb means 'to look'?
b1-adj-bereit: Your friend has packed his bags and put on his shoes. He says he can go now.
The student is willing to help with the project and says he is prepared.
Dinner is cooked and the table is set. Which adjective means 'ready'?
b1-n-verlust: You lost your wallet and with it all your money and cards.
The company made less money than it spent, so it ended the year with negative numbers.
The family is sad after the death of the grandfather and feels a big emptiness. Which word means 'loss'?
b1-n-pfleger: A man in the hospital changes the patient's bandage and checks his temperature.
In a care home for old people, a man helps the residents wash and eat.
A man works with the sick on the ward. Which word means a 'male nurse'?
b1-v-nutzen: You have a free hour, so you make good use of it to study.
It is a sunny day, so you take advantage of it for a picnic.
Many people employ the bike lanes every day. Which verb means 'to use'?
b1-n-verbrecher: A man robs banks and the police look for him. He breaks the law seriously.
In the film, the detective chases a man who has committed serious crimes.
The prison holds men who broke the law. Which word means 'criminal'?
b1-n-verhalten: The teacher is not pleased with how the students act in class, too loud and rude.
A zoo researcher watches how the monkeys act in groups.
A child shows good manners at the table. Which word means 'behaviour'?
b1-adv-eben: You are in the kitchen and your friend asks where your sister is. You say she was here a moment ago.
You have only now finished the report. You finished it moments ago.
Your phone rang a second ago. Which adverb means 'just now'?
b1-adj-extrem: In the desert, the temperature goes far beyond the normal.
She climbs mountains in the most dangerous conditions, a sport with great risks.
The cold in Siberia in winter is beyond ordinary. Which adjective means 'extreme'?
b1-n-orchester: In the concert hall, about eighty musicians with violins, flutes and drums play together under a conductor.
A conductor stands in front of a group of musicians playing classical music.
The school has a big group of students playing violins, flutes and trumpets together. Which word means 'orchestra'?
b1-v-verlassen: At six you walk out of the house and close the door behind you.
A father walks away from his family and leaves them alone.
The passengers go out of the train at the last stop. Which verb means 'to leave'?
b1-n-inserat: You want to sell your bicycle, so you put a short text with a photo in the newspaper's market section.
You read the 'rooms for rent' notes in the newspaper.
A small notice in the paper offers a used sofa for sale. Which word means 'advertisement'?
b1-n-kiste: You pack old books into a wooden container with a lid for the move.
At the market, apples are sold in wooden containers.
A strong container made of wood or plastic is used for transport. Which word means 'crate'?
b1-v-uebernehmen: Your boss leaves the company, and you now take charge of his tasks.
At the restaurant, a friend says: 'I will pay the bill.' He takes it over.
You agree to look after the project from now on. Which verb means 'to take over'?
b1-n-staub: You have not cleaned the shelf for months and a grey layer covers it.
When the car drives on the dry road, a cloud of fine dry earth rises.
Your finger writes in the fine grey powder on the table. Which word means 'dust'?
b1-adj-niedrig: The ceiling in the cellar is so close to your head that you must bend.
The price of the ticket is small, far less than you expected.
The bridge is not high, and the fence is only waist-high. Which adjective means 'low'?
b1-n-runde: In a boxing match, there are twelve parts of three minutes each.
The runner completes one lap of the track.
At the pub, you buy drinks for everyone in the group because it is your turn. Which word means 'round'?
b1-v-bewegen: The doctor tells you to move your arm slowly up and down.
The wind makes the leaves shift.
You cannot lift the heavy sofa. You cannot shift it from its place. Which verb means 'to move' something?
b1-n-lippe: In winter in the cold wind, the soft skin around your mouth gets dry and cracked.
You apply colour on the edges of your mouth before going out.
You press the edges of your mouth together to stay quiet. Which word means 'lip'?
b1-n-nahrungsmittel: The supermarket sells bread, milk, rice and eggs, things people eat to live.
After the flood, aid workers give out things to eat to the villagers.
In a store, the shelves contain things we can eat. Which word means 'food'?
b1-adj-frech: A boy sticks out his tongue at the teacher and answers back rudely.
A child says to an adult: 'You are old!' with a smirk, showing no respect but not meaning harm.
Your neighbour's son talks to you in a bold, disrespectful way. Which adjective means 'cheeky'?
b1-n-kraft: The weightlifter needs great physical power to raise the heavy bar.
The wind has such force that it blows the roof off.
After a good night's sleep you feel full of energy. Which word means 'strength'?
b1-v-verwechseln: You take someone else's umbrella because it looks just like yours.
You think that Maria is Anna. They look alike, so you call her by the wrong name.
The pharmacist gave you the wrong medicine by confusing two boxes. Which verb means 'to mix up'?
b1-n-einzelkind: A girl has no brothers or sisters and grows up alone with her parents.
In your class, one boy says he has never shared a room with a sibling.
Your friend is the only child in the family. Which word means 'only child'?
b1-adv-gleichfalls: Someone says: 'Have a nice weekend!' and you answer: 'The same to you!'
The waiter says: 'Enjoy your meal!' and you politely wish him the same.
A friend wishes you luck, and you want to say it back. Which adverb means 'likewise'?
b1-n-umleitung: The road is closed because of construction, and signs send you along a different route.
A yellow sign shows an arrow telling drivers to go another way around.
The bridge is closed, so the traffic takes a longer route. Which word means 'detour'?
b1-v-erziehen: Parents teach their children good manners, how to behave and to be honest, for many years.
A single mother is raising two kids on her own.
A grandmother helped to look after and form the grandchildren as they grew up. Which verb means 'to bring up'?
b1-n-erde: Astronauts look out of the spaceship window at the blue planet where we live.
In the garden, you dig in the dark brown soil and plant seeds.
A farmer picks up a handful of soil and lets it fall through his fingers. Which word means 'earth' or 'soil'?
b1-adj-intensiv: Before the exam, you study eight hours a day, very hard and focused.
The colours in the painting are very strong and bright.
The patients in this ward get very thorough care. Which adjective describes this kind of 'intensive' care?
b1-n-gebrauchsanweisung: You buy a new coffee machine and unfold a paper leaflet that explains how to operate it.
The medicine box includes a leaflet that explains how to take the tablets.
You cannot work out how to start the washing machine, so you search for the booklet that explains it. Which word means 'user manual'?
b1-n-einkommen: The tax office asks how much money you earn a year from all sources.
A family with a low monthly sum of money coming in gets help from the state.
A form asks for your yearly earnings from work. Which word means 'income'?
b1-v-treten: In the football game, the player strikes the ball with his foot.
You move one foot forward and put it on the first stair.
You accidentally put your foot on someone's toes in the bus. Which verb means 'to step' on something?
b1-n-braten: On Sunday, mum cooks a big piece of meat in the oven with gravy.
Your grandmother serves a big piece of pork cooked in the oven with potatoes.
A butcher sells a large piece of beef for the oven. Which word means 'roast'?
b1-n-schrift: You can hardly read the old letter because the style of the letters is so strange.
In the document program, you choose the style of letters and the size for the text.
Archaeologists found stone tablets covered with signs of an ancient language, an early writing system. Which word means 'script'?
b1-adj-knapp: In a dry summer, water becomes hard to get. There is not enough of it.
He passed the exam by a tiny margin, just barely.
The trousers are very tight around the waist. Which adjective means 'tight'?
b1-v-trennen: You put plastic, paper and glass in different bins for waste.
You pull the plug out of the socket to cut the connection to the power.
A wall divides the room into two parts. Which verb means 'to separate'?
b1-n-verletzung: The football player falls and has a broken leg. He must miss the next games.
The police report that a driver broke traffic rules, a breach of the law.
The doctor looks at the damage to your ankle after you fell. Which word means 'injury'?
b1-n-kueste: You drive to the place where the land ends and the sea begins and walk along the beach.
A lighthouse stands where the land meets the sea.
A ship sails near the edge of the land. Which word means 'coast'?
b1-v-sich-beteiligen: Everyone in the class joins the discussion and gives an opinion.
A company puts some money into the project, too.
You sign up for the charity run and take part. Which verb means 'to participate'?
b1-n-salbe: You have dry, red skin on your elbow, and the doctor gives you a creamy medicine to rub on it.
After a bee sting, you put a soothing cream on the red spot.
The pharmacy sells a thick medical cream in a tube. Which word means 'ointment'?
b1-adv-wochentags: The shop is open Monday to Friday but closed on Sunday. What does the sign say about those days?
On days when people work, the train is full. On Sundays, it is empty.
The restaurant opens at 7 am from Monday to Friday, but later at the weekend. Which adverb means 'on weekdays'?
b1-adj-huebsch: She wears a nice dress and her face is lovely to look at.
The village has charming little houses with flowers.
A friend shows you a photo of a cute girl. Which adjective means 'pretty'?
b1-n-aussicht: From the top floor window you look at the mountains and the lake.
After finishing your studies, your chances of getting a good job are high.
The hotel room has a lovely sight of the sea. Which word means 'view'?
b1-n-alphabet: In the first grade, children learn the letters from A to Z in order.
You sing a song with all the letters of a language in order.
Words in a dictionary are arranged by the order of letters. Which word means 'alphabet'?
b1-v-aussuchen: In the shoe shop you look at ten pairs and pick the black ones.
In the bakery, you take your time deciding which cake to buy.
The teacher asks each student to select a topic. Which verb means 'to choose'?
b1-n-foerderung: A company gives money to young artists to help them develop their talent.
The state helps the student with a grant to pay for his studies.
Employers support the training of workers. Which word means 'support' or 'sponsorship'?
b1-n-botschaft: You lost your passport abroad and go to the official building of your country in that capital to get help.
The speech carries an important point to the people. What is its main point?
A diplomat works at the official representation of a country in a foreign capital. Which word means 'embassy'?
b1-adj-positiv: The doctor says the result is favourable and the news is good.
Your attitude is optimistic. You always see the good side.
The teacher gives feedback with praise. Which adjective means 'positive'?
b1-v-hinterlassen: You write a note and put it on the table before you go out so that your family reads it.
The old man died and gave his house to his children as an inheritance.
The guest wrote a message in the hotel's book before going. Which verb means 'to leave' something behind?
b1-n-spiegel: In the bathroom, you look at your face on a glass surface on the wall.
In the car, you check the traffic behind you using a small glass on the side.
Snow White's stepmother asked a magic one on the wall. Which word means 'mirror'?
b1-n-medizin: A young woman studies for six years at university to become a doctor.
The doctor gives you tablets from the pharmacy.
The pharmacy sells drugs for illness. Which word means 'medicine'?
b1-n-schnitzel: In a German restaurant, you order a thin piece of meat covered with breadcrumbs and fried, with potatoes.
Mum flattens a thin slice of pork or veal, covers it with crumbs and fries it.
A famous Viennese dish is a breaded fried cutlet. Which word means 'schnitzel'?
b1-v-verbringen: During summer, you stay at your grandparents' village for two weeks, passing the time.
You like to pass your evenings reading at home.
How do you pass your weekends? Which verb means 'to spend' time?
b1-adj-rechtzeitig: You arrive at the station five minutes before the train leaves. You did not miss it.
The ambulance came early enough to save the patient.
You hand in your homework before the deadline. Which adjective means 'in time'?
b1-n-socke: It is cold, so you put something soft on your foot before your shoes.
After washing, one of the pair is missing and you cannot find the other.
Your grandmother knits a woollen piece for your foot as a Christmas present. Which word means 'sock'?
b1-n-abschnitt: The article is divided into three parts, and you read the second part.
A road is under construction in one stretch between two exits.
In your essay, the teacher marks one part under a separate heading. Which word means 'section'?
b1-v-eintreten: You knock on the door, open it and walk into the office.
You decide to become a member of the club. You go in as a member.
The doctor says: 'If a fever sets in, call me.' Which verb means 'to occur' or 'to join'?
b1-adv-rauf: You stand at the bottom of the stairs and say: 'Come ___ here!' Which small word means 'up'?
A hill is in front of you and your friend says: 'Let's go ___!' Which adverb means 'up'?
The cat is in the garden and the child says: 'Climb ___ the tree.' Which word means 'up' as a direction?
b1-n-spritze: At the doctor's, the nurse prepares a needle to put medicine in your arm.
Before travelling, you get a vaccination in your upper arm.
It is a tool with a plunger and a needle. Which word means 'syringe'?
b1-n-konfituere: On your breakfast bread you spread a sweet fruit preserve made from strawberries.
Grandma cooks fruit with sugar and fills glass jars.
In the supermarket you pick a jar of sweet fruit spread. Which word means 'jam'?
b1-adj-flexibel: Your boss lets you start work at eight or at ten, depending on what suits you.
A rubber band can be bent a lot and does not break.
You are ready to change plans quickly if needed. Which adjective means 'flexible'?
b1-v-wetten: You say to your friend: 'I will give you 10 euros if our team does not win.'
At the horse races, people put money on a horse.
You are sure it will rain tomorrow and offer to risk money on it. Which verb means 'to bet'?
b1-n-intensivkurs: Before moving to Germany, you attend a language course every day for six hours for one month.
A summer school offers a very fast and demanding course of four weeks, every day.
You choose a short, hard, full-time course to learn quickly. Which word means 'intensive course'?
b1-n-golf: On a big grass course with small holes, a player hits a little white ball with a club.
A famous sport is played outdoors on large green areas, and players carry many clubs in a bag.
Which sport uses clubs, a small ball and eighteen holes?
b1-n-werkzeug: You open the toolbox and take out a hammer, a screwdriver and pliers.
A mechanic needs the right instrument to loosen the screw.
A hammer is something you use to do work with your hands. Which word means 'tool'?
b1-v-reichen: You have 10 euros. The ticket costs 8. Is that enough?
The food in the fridge will last until Sunday.
At the table, you ask someone to hand you the salt. Which verb means 'to pass'?
b1-n-huegel: The village lies on a small rise in the landscape, lower than a mountain.
The children roll down a small grassy rise in the park.
Between the flat fields, a small elevated area rises. Which word means 'hill'?
b1-adj-schief: The picture on the wall is not hanging straight. One corner is lower than the other.
The tower of the old church is leaning to one side.
Your line on the paper goes up and down, not straight. Which adjective means 'crooked'?
b1-n-kaeufer: A man looks at your old car and says he wants to pay for it.
In an online shop, a man puts the product in his cart and pays.
The seller waits for a man who will pay for the flat. Which word means a male 'buyer'?
b1-v-erhalten: A letter arrives in your mailbox and you take it.
The old building is still in good condition because the city keeps it from falling apart.
You get a prize for your results. Which verb means 'to receive'?
b1-n-taste: On the piano, you press a white or black bar to make a sound.
On your computer keyboard, you press the one marked 'Enter'.
The calculator has a small pad for each number. Which word means 'key' or 'button'?
b1-n-netz: Fishermen throw a mesh of strings into the sea to catch fish.
Your phone shows no connection to the system of mobile signals.
A spider builds a pattern of threads between two branches to catch insects. Which word means 'web' or 'net'?
b1-adv-mitten: The tree stands exactly halfway between the two ends of the field, neither near one side nor the other.
The phone rang while you were in the centre of an important meeting.
A small island lies in the very centre of the lake. Which adverb means 'in the middle'?
